description:
Turn running footage into clear, editor-ready data stories.

DataLayer Studio brings videos and FIT/GPX activity files together on a lightweight multitrack timeline. Align real-world moments, design readable telemetry overlays, then export a transparent Alpha layer or a finished video with sound.

• Import multiple videos and FIT/GPX activity files
• Move, trim, split, snap, and organize clips across video and activity tracks
• Preview pace, distance, heart rate, cadence, route, time, weather, power, running dynamics, and more
• Arrange every data widget directly on the canvas and reuse layout presets
• Save timeline projects and relink moved or missing media
• Export a full timeline or individual clips as HEVC/ProRes Alpha overlays or HEVC/H.264 composited videos

Built for Apple silicon, DataLayer Studio keeps the workflow local, visual, and ready for professional editing.
promotionalText: Build complete running stories on a lightweight multitrack timeline—align multiple videos and FIT/GPX clips, then export Alpha overlays or finished videos.
whatsNew:
• A new lightweight multitrack timeline for multiple videos and activity files
• Move, trim, split, snap, multi-select, and move clips between tracks of the same type
• Audio waveforms on video tracks, with upper video tracks covering lower tracks
• FIT pauses preserved in real time, with black canvas or transparency for gaps
• Save and open timeline projects, and relink offline media
• Export the full timeline or multiple individual clips
• Improved mixed-orientation media, weather data, undo/redo, and sandboxed export reliability
